blast_radius: Writes a digest and evidence file per night; no code changes.

throughput.derivation: Count of files per dated directory under var/reflection/. Dated directories are a real count, unlike a log mtime.
notes: History can have real gaps; absent days are not imputed as zero, they are simply outside the sample.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: Nightly reflection digest; volume is artifacts written under var/reflection/<date>/.
why_it_matters: The reflection digest is the estate's only nightly self-review; silence here reads as 'nothing went wrong' when it means 'nothing was checked'.
